2002 series · Season 3: Night Monkey 2 / The Abduction · directed by Jeff Tremaine

Does Brad Pitt die in Jackass?

He plays Himself, a cameo role.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Kidnapped at Pink's Hot Dogs, but it's a prank.

Pitt turned up in two Season 3 episodes of MTV's Jackass in 2002. In 'Night Monkey 2' he dons a gorilla suit with Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Chris Pontius and Steve-O and rampages through the streets of Los Angeles. In 'The Abduction' he stands in line at Pink's Hot Dogs in Hollywood when masked men grab him, drag him thrashing into a van and drive off while horrified bystanders try to intervene. It's all staged; he walks away unharmed.

Reality/prank TV, no fictional character. Pitt does not appear in Jackass Number Two (2006) despite frequent misattribution.
